job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior GenAI Engineer to join our team at Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Ltd. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with the ability to develop and implement advanced AI solutions.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop scalable and efficient AI models using genetic algorithms.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines for training and testing AI models.


Conduct research and stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning.


Work closely with stakeholders to identify business problems and develop AI solutions.


Deploy and monitor AI models in production environments.




Job Requirements




Strong understanding of genetic algorithms and their applications in insurance industry.


Experience with large datasets and developing scalable data pipelines.


Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively with teams.


Strong communication and interpersonal skills.


Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field; Master's degree preferred.




Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
